title: Order the board's lanes by last change, and mark stalled hand-backs
body:
## Summary

Spec-only change. The board stopped hoisting Needs a person lanes and orders every unfinished lane by its last change; a stall is a new kind of hand-back with its own label and card line.

```diff
 Order of lanes
-  lanes with a card in Needs a person, by number
-  other unfinished lanes, by number
+  unfinished lanes, latest changed first
+    a run in flight is happening now
   finished lanes, latest finished first

 Card line
+  Triage, Needs a person, Ready: ends with how long it has sat in its column
+  Needs a person: "stalled"           when it holds linewright:stalled
+  In review:      "stalled"           before "checks failed" etc.

 Hand-back
+  a stall: the work failed, no decision wanted
+    labels linewright:stalled, cleared when Linewright next works the item
+    explain says the item is stalled
```

Files: `docs/specs/design_system.md`, `docs/specs/repository.md`, `docs/specs/monitoring.md`, `GLOSSARY.md` (new term **Stall**).

## Evidence

- **Before:** the lanes with a hand-back or needs-info card sat at the top of the board for days while implementation runs and reviews sat below them; the order within a group was issue number, so the rule was not visible on the page.
  **After:** spec review found five issues in the draft (cases instead of a rule, a wrong derivation for spec changes, an undecided Working card, a rule stated three times, and one question); four fixed, the fifth kept as decided. `scripts/check` passes: 947 tests, fmt, markdown, clippy, doc.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

The spec leads the code; this merge changes what is to be built, not what runs. Reverting the spec is a revert of four Markdown files.

**Blast Radius:** board

The code that follows will reorder every lane on the board and add a label to the repository's label set. Nothing changes until that code lands.
